LEGAL COMPLIANCE

Privacy Policy

ZAQSA Tech and Solutions Private Limited ("we," "our," or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy and organizational data. This policy explains our data collection, encryption, and confidentiality protocols.

1. Information We Collect

When you submit an enquiry via our portfolio, we collect your name, business email, phone number, organization name, and project specifications. We do not sell, rent, or lease client data to third parties under any circumstances.

2. NDA & Project Confidentiality

We treat all technical briefs, architecture ideas, and business specifications as strictly confidential. Prior to commencing development, ZAQSA Tech routinely executes comprehensive Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) to safeguard proprietary intellectual property.

3. Data Security & Storage

All transmitted information is secured using industry-standard TLS/SSL encryption. System logs and database access credentials follow Zero-Trust and role-based access protocols.

4. Contact & Compliance

For inquiries regarding data privacy or to request removal of your contact information, contact our data protection team at contact@zaqsa.com.

TERMS OF SERVICE

Terms & Conditions

Welcome to ZAQSA Tech and Solutions Private Limited. By accessing this website or engaging our services, you agree to these Terms and Conditions.

1. Scope of Digital Services

ZAQSA Tech provides custom software engineering, cloud architecture, mobile development, web applications, and artificial intelligence solutions governed by individual Statements of Work (SOW) and service agreements.

2. Intellectual Property (IP) Ownership

Upon final settlement of contract invoices, all bespoke source code, design assets, and deployment artifacts created specifically for the client become the exclusive property of the client, unless otherwise stipulated in the master agreement.

3. Warranties & SLAs

We provide warranty periods and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for bugs and technical remediation as detailed in our formal project contracts.

4. Jurisdiction

These terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of New Delhi, India.
